description: This file defines the class SheetViewOptions used in the PhpSpreadsheet library to parse and apply sheet view options from an XLSX file, including settings like tab color, sheet protection, outlines, page setup, and print options.

classes.name: SheetViewOptions
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and applying sheet view options from an XLSX worksheet XML, including appearance and layout settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SheetViewOptions with a Worksheet object and optional worksheet XML.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and applies various sheet view options from the XML, such as sheet protection, layout, print options, based on the readDataOnly flag.

methods.name: tabColor
methods.description: Sets the tab color of the worksheet if specified in the XML.

methods.name: codeName
methods.description: Sets the code name of the worksheet if specified in XML attributes.

methods.name: outlines
methods.description: Configures outline display options for the worksheet based on XML attributes.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Sets page setup options like 'fit to page' based on XML attributes.

methods.name: sheetFormat
methods.description: Applies default row heights and column widths from XML attributes.

methods.name: printOptions
methods.description: Configures print and gridline options based on XML attributes.
